attributes.description: The right singular vectors of the input data.
attributes.name: components_

attributes.description:
The variance of the training samples transformed by a projection to
each component.
attributes.name: explained_variance_

attributes.description: Percentage of variance explained by each of the selected components.
attributes.name: explained_variance_ratio_

attributes.description:
The singular values corresponding to each of the selected components.
The singular values are equal to the 2-norms of the ``n_components``
variables in the lower-dimensional space.
attributes.name: singular_values_

attributes.description:
Number of features seen during :term:`fit`.

.. versionadded:: 0.24
attributes.name: n_features_in_

attributes.description:
Names of features seen during :term:`fit`. Defined only when `X`
has feature names that are all strings.

.. versionadded:: 1.0
attributes.name: feature_names_in_

methods.name: fit
methods.summary: Fit model on training data X.

methods.name: fit_transform
methods.summary: Fit model to X and perform dimensionality reduction on X.

methods.name: get_feature_names_out
methods.summary: Get output feature names for transformation.

methods.name: get_metadata_routing
methods.summary: Get metadata routing of this object.

methods.name: set_params
methods.summary: Set the parameters of this estimator.

parameters.description:
Desired dimensionality of output data.
If algorithm='arpack', must be strictly less than the number of features.
If algorithm='randomized', must be less than or equal to the number of features.
The default value is useful for visualisation. For LSA, a value of
100 is recommended.
parameters.name: n_components

parameters.description:
SVD solver to use. Either "arpack" for the ARPACK wrapper in SciPy
(scipy.sparse.linalg.svds), or "randomized" for the randomized
algorithm due to Halko (2009).
parameters.name: algorithm

parameters.description:
Number of iterations for randomized SVD solver. Not used by ARPACK. The
default is larger than the default in
:func:`~sklearn.utils.extmath.randomized_svd` to handle sparse
matrices that may have large slowly decaying spectrum.
parameters.name: n_iter

parameters.description:
Number of oversamples for randomized SVD solver. Not used by ARPACK.
See :func:`~sklearn.utils.extmath.randomized_svd` for a complete
description.

.. versionadded:: 1.1
parameters.name: n_oversamples

parameters.description:
Power iteration normalizer for randomized SVD solver.
Not used by ARPACK. See :func:`~sklearn.utils.extmath.randomized_svd`
for more details.

.. versionadded:: 1.1
parameters.name: power_iteration_normalizer

parameters.description:
Used during randomized svd. Pass an int for reproducible results across
multiple function calls.
See :term:`Glossary <random_state>`.
parameters.name: random_state
parameters.type_doc: int, RandomState instance or None, default=None

parameters.description:
Tolerance for ARPACK. 0 means machine precision. Ignored by randomized
SVD solver.
parameters.name: tol
